'''An'Kwee''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Swooper/Legends|swooper]] who resided on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she was part of a group of [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racers]] in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]], along with [[Draknus]].<ref name="SWG:PR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she agreed to help a spacer to find the crash site of one of her fellow pilot who crashed his [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] on the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] circuit. The aim of the spacer was to retrieve a [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]] [[Motivator/Legends|motivator]] that was used in this podracer. Both [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]] dispatched agents to find the parts of that R2 unit.<ref name="SWG:PR" />

==Behind the scenes==
An'Kwee appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts,<ref name="SWG:PR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> An'Kwee was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
